name: Isagi

stats.counters: get a 2 HU step between you and him, or jump after the release flash, or sidestep >= 0.9 u; on a lane anchor a jump per volley (0.75 s apart) clears even Egoist bursts, and he is gone within 4.0 s
stats.tell: the idle pose flashes with an accelerating red rim, a thin red aim line snaps onto you, and the direct-shot voice cue plays 1.2 s before the balls

behavior: fires rapid projectile bursts in your direction; an audio cue precedes each burst, short cooldown between bursts. Time your movement between bursts.
tell: wind-up 1.2 s (idle sprite flashes + voice cue)
counter_play: get a 2 HU step between you and him, or jump after the release flash (the jump stays above 1.5 u for 0.43 s — longer than a volley's 0.30 s spread), or sidestep ≥ 0.9 u where the path allows; on a lane anchor a jump per volley (0.75 s apart) clears Egoist bursts too, and he is gone within 4.0 s.
